description: Baseline release: one bundle carrying every patch for every supported app.

patches.name: Clone package
patches.description: Installs the patched build under its own application id (app.xiondigital.atoz by default), so it can sit next to the official Amazon A to Z instead of replacing it. Renames the provider authorities, the app's runtime permission and the launcher label, and drops the Amazon SDK permission declarations a re-signed build cannot own. Off by default: a clone starts empty, and Play services, FCM targeting, attestation and verified App Links stay bound to the original package.

options.description: Application id the patched build installs as. Must not be com.amazon.atozm.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Turns on Amazon A to Z's night mode before the first screen is created and opts the app into Android's automatic dark transform, so the interface is dark even when the phone is set to light mode.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP checks
patches.description: Skips PairIP's APK signature and Play licence checks, which otherwise stop a re-signed build from starting. Required for any patched Tandem build to run.

patches.name: Clone package
patches.description: Installs the patched build under its own application id (app.xiondigital.tandem by default), so it can sit next to the official Tandem app instead of replacing and conflicting with it. Off by default: a clone starts empty, and Google/Facebook sign-in, push tokens, Play purchases and verified App Links stay bound to the original package.

options.description: Application id the patched build installs as. Must not be net.tandem.

patches.name: Disable Adjust tracking
patches.description: Stops the bundled Adjust attribution SDK from initialising, so no install, session or event attribution is sent.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Turns on Tandem's own dark theme, regardless of the system dark-mode setting.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes Tandem's community ad slot and blocks the bundled AppLovin MAX and Meta Audience Network SDKs from requesting ads.

release_notes: Baseline release. One bundle, every supported app: five Tandem patches and two Amazon A to Z patches. Versions from here move by one patch at a time.
repoDescription: Android application patches for Morphe utilization.
